faqs.question: Can I cancel at any time?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can cancel your plan at any time without penalties.

faqs.question: Is there a trial period?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer a 7-day free trial on all plans.

faqs.question: What payment methods are accepted?
faqs.answer: We accept credit card, boleto, and PIX.

faqs.question: Is there support?
faqs.answer: Yes, all plans include support. More advanced plans have priority.
